scores.label: A
scores.note: Firm pressure, elevation, tourniquet if pressure fails, call 911. No add-layers advice; call listed third; wound cleaning clutter.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Calls 911 first, pressure, tourniquet if trained. Misses adding layers without removing; long wound-care detail.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Call help, firm pressure, add layers without lifting, shock watch. No tourniquet for life-threatening limb bleeding.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Good call/pressure/re-apply advice, but wrongly says never use a tourniquet on an arm, contradicting guidance.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Pressure 'firm but gentle' and call only if not stopping. No add-layers, no tourniquet option.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Call 911, firm direct pressure, add layers without removing, tourniquet high on arm if pressure fails, shock care.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Wrong: says gentle pressure, don't press hard, no tourniquet, don't use clothing or towels for pressure.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Pressure and elevation, but outdated pressure points with wrong arteries; 911 only if signs appear; no tourniquet.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Says gentle pressure, not too hard; 911 only after 10-15 min. Tourniquet mentioned; no add-layers.

scores.label: J
scores.note: Firm pressure, add layers without removing, call help. No tourniquet option; call framed conditionally.

scores.label: K
scores.note: Direct pressure, tourniquet/hemostatic if fails. Calls 911 only if unconscious, otherwise asks victim to call; no add-layers.

scores.label: A
scores.note: Cool water 10-15 min, no ice, remove jewelry, hands need care. Recommends ointments/silver sulfadiazine against no-creams guidance.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Cool 10+ min right, but recommends burn cream/aloe, no ring removal, does not flag hand burns for care.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Cooling and jewelry right, but antibiotic ointment, hydrocortisone creams; hand burns not flagged for care.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Cool 10+ min, no ice/butter, hands flagged, keep blisters. Recommends aloe/gel; rings not named.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Cooling, jewelry, hands and blistering flagged for care. Recommends antibiotic and lidocaine/benzocaine creams.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Cool 10-15 min, no ice, jewelry, hands flagged. Recommends aloe/burn cream; prevention padding.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Cool water and jewelry removal right; antibiotic and benzocaine creams; hand burns not flagged for medical care.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Cools only 'several minutes' (guidance 10-20). No creams, covers, blistering flagged; hands not flagged.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Cool 10-15 min, no ice/butter, jewelry, hands flagged. Recommends aloe/silver sulfadiazine ointment.

scores.label: A
scores.note: About 28 days at room temperature is right; invented stopper/pen categories (42, 14 days).

scores.label: B
scores.note: 28-30 days, below 86F, avoid heat, check manufacturer. Correct main point; minor vagueness by type.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Wrong: claims hours to 2-3 days; suggests dry ice, which can freeze insulin.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Wrong: opened vials discard after 1 week; discard insulin after 2-6 hour outage.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Glargine 28 days and 86F right; Humalog 24 hours, Fiasp 14 days wrong; invented names.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Wrong: limits of hours and says discard after 8 hours; guidance is about 28 days.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Says 3-7 days, far short of 28; misclassifies Lantus. Heat and label advice right.

scores.label: H
scores.note: 28 days opened and unopened is right; odd advice to refrigerate opened ones; no freeze warning.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Wrong: claims 4-hour limit, attributed to ADA; says discard after 4 hours.

scores.label: A
scores.note: Not recommended; use flashlights/lanterns; if used, never unattended, away from flammables.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Frames candles as safe with precautions; holders, unattended, flammables right; flashlights only an afterthought.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Says can be safe; errors (paraffin 'natural', 'tunnel vision'); precautions present, flashlights secondary.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Says safe with precautions: stable holder, unattended, flammables. Flashlights only listed last.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Fire risk, stable surface, flashlights safer. Omits never unattended; dubious oxygen claim.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Risks, 12 inches from flammables, never unattended, flashlight alternatives. No stable holder advice.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Not recommended, flashlights/lanterns instead. No precautions if used; odd heat point.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Precautions right (unattended, holder, flammables); says can be safe; odd collapse/electrical points.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Full precautions list, but presents candles as effective; only LED candles as alternative, no flashlights.

scores.label: A
scores.note: Dim screen, radios off, airplane, battery saver right. Software updates and removing cases are wrong tips.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Most tips right, but says avoid charging because it drains battery; developer options clutter.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Radios off right; no low power mode or brightness; false claim charging a dead battery damages phone.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Battery saver, brightness, radios, airplane, power bank right; odd 'unplug charging cable' tip.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Radios off, brightness, airplane, power saving, car/portable charger. Misses texting over calls.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Core tips right; nonsense about body heat generating power.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Brightness, radios, airplane, low power, power bank right; nonsense about darkness and keeping still.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Brightness, radios, airplane, battery saver, close apps, car or battery pack charging. Misses texting.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Low power mode, brightness, radios off right. No airplane mode, power bank or texting.

scores.label: A
scores.note: Damaged cans discard right; contradicts itself on cleaning; ends discard all; no sanitize-and-save for undamaged cans.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Says not safe, discard; misses that undamaged commercial cans can be washed, sanitized and kept.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Contradictory; relies on heating food; no label removal or sanitizing; no home-canned distinction.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Discard damaged right; suggests smell/taste tests; says discard all; misses sanitize-and-save.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Discard all is overcautious; invented seep mechanisms; misses saving undamaged commercial cans.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Says discard all even if fine; misses sanitizing undamaged commercial cans.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Damaged cans discard right; suggests tasting and cooking; no can sanitizing step.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Wrongly attributes discard-all to FDA; misses sanitize-and-save; odd weight test.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Clear but says discard all; misses that undamaged commercial cans can be sanitized and kept.
